1.w: And YHWH had said to Abram, “Go for yourself from your land and from your kindred and from the house of your father, to the land that I will show you.

2.w: And I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you and I will make great your name, and you shall be a blessing.

3.w: And I will bless those blessing you, and him who curses you I will curse, and in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed.”

4.w: And Abram departed as YHWH had spoken to him, and Lot departed with him. And Abram [was] a son of five years and seventy years when he went out from Haran.

5.w: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot, son of his brother, and all their possessions that they had gathered, and the souls whom they had made in Haran, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan. And they came to the land of Canaan.

6.w: And Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, as far as the Oak of Moreh. And at that time the Canaanite [was] in the land.

7.w: And YHWH appeared to Abram and said, “To your seed I will give this land.” And he built there an altar to YHWH, who had appeared to him.

8.w: And he moved on from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and he pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. And he built there an altar to YHWH, and he called on the name of YHWH.

9.w: And Abram journeyed, going on and journeying toward the Negev.

10.w: And there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, for the famine [was] severe in the land.

11.w: And it came to pass when he was close to entering Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, “Behold now, I know that you [are] a woman beautiful in appearance.

12.w: And it will come to pass when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, ‘This [is] his wife.’ And they will kill me, and you they will let live.

13.w: Say, please, you [are] my sister, so that it may go well with me for your sake, and my soul may live because of you.”

14.w: And it came to pass, when Abram entered Egypt, that the Egyptians saw the woman, that she [was] very beautiful.

15.w: And the princes of Pharaoh saw her, and they commended her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken into the house of Pharaoh.

16.w: And Abram he treated well for her sake, and he had for himself sheep, and cattle, and male donkeys, and menservants, and maidservants, and female donkeys, and camels.

17.w: And YHWH plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of the matter [of] Sarai, wife of Abram.

18.w: And Pharaoh called to Abram and said, “What [is] this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she [was] your wife?

19.w: Why did you say, ‘She [is] my sister,’ so that I took her to myself as a wife? And now, behold, your wife; take [her] and go!”

20.w: And Pharaoh commanded [his] men concerning him, and they sent him away, and his wife, and all that he had.
